description: This file defines an interface for building answer responses for live commands related to retrieving feature properties, specifically for the RetrieveFeatureProperty command within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending LiveCommandAnswerBuilder for creating response steps for the RetrieveFeatureProperty command.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Nested interface for producing command responses, including successful retrieval and error responses.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response containing the retrieved feature property value.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating that the feature property does not exist or access is denied.
